comment: Hand-maintained facts the extractor cannot infer (design 5.3 step 4).
is_regex: the value is compiled as a regular expression. values: every value the option
accepts from a config file (a key always passes a value there); anything else makes the
callback return FALSE, which GOption turns into a fatal 'Error parsing option'.
Ranges are explicit: the generator warns when an option outlives its entry. Before
extending one, check the evidence in the newer source (-export-src, -func-history).
Callbacks deliberately left out: protocol (prefix match on tcp/socket), stream (strtol prefix),
compress before v0.19.3-1 (case-sensitive prefix of GZIP/ZSTD), drop-table (TRUNCATE is
case-sensitive, the other modes are not, and the empty value is accepted), and free-form values.

options.name: regex
options.evidence: src/regex.c: regex_arguments_callback appends each value to regex_list; initialize_regex compiles every entry with init_regex (pcre2_compile, caseless and multiline). initialize_regex is called by mydumper (mydumper_start_dump.c) and myloader (myloader.c). The three functions are token-identical v0.19.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: partition-regex
options.evidence: src/mydumper/mydumper_arguments.c: the entry stores into partition_regex; mydumper_start_dump.c passes it to initialize_regex (src/regex.c), which compiles it with init_regex (pcre2_compile). Same in every version v0.19.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: compress
options.evidence: src/mydumper/mydumper_arguments.c arguments_callback: a value is compared with g_ascii_strcasecmp to GZIP and ZSTD ("gzip", "zstd" in src/common.h); otherwise control reaches common_arguments_callback (src/common.c, later src/common_options.c), which returns FALSE. No value: auto-detection. Branch unchanged v0.19.3-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: format
options.evidence: src/mydumper/mydumper_arguments.c arguments_callback: g_ascii_strcasecmp against INSERT_ARG, LOAD_DATA_ARG, CSV_ARG, CLICKHOUSE_ARG (src/mydumper/mydumper_arguments.h); otherwise common_arguments_callback returns FALSE. Branch unchanged v0.19.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: sync-thread-lock-mode
options.evidence: src/mydumper/mydumper_arguments.c arguments_callback: g_ascii_strcasecmp against five literal modes; otherwise common_arguments_callback (src/common.c) returns FALSE. v0.19.1-1..v0.19.3-3.

options.name: sync-thread-lock-mode
options.evidence: src/mydumper/mydumper_arguments.c arguments_callback: SAFE_NO_LOCK added in v0.20.1-1, same g_ascii_strcasecmp tests; otherwise common_arguments_callback (src/common_options.c) returns FALSE. Branch unchanged v0.20.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: source-control-command
options.evidence: common_arguments_callback (src/common.c until v0.19.3-3, src/common_options.c from v0.20.1-1): strcasecmp against TRADITIONAL and AWS, else the function returns FALSE. Checked in each of its six distinct bodies v0.19.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: optimize-keys
options.evidence: src/myloader/myloader_arguments.c arguments_callback: strcasecmp against SKIP, AFTER_IMPORT_PER_TABLE, AFTER_IMPORT_ALL_TABLES (src/myloader/myloader_arguments.h); anything else logs a critical and falls through to common_arguments_callback, which returns FALSE. "1" is not accepted before v0.20.1-1.

options.name: optimize-keys
options.evidence: src/myloader/myloader_arguments.c arguments_callback: v0.20.1-1 also accepts "1" (exact; no letters); the three modes are compared case-insensitively (strcasecmp, then g_ascii_strcasecmp from v0.20.2-2); else common_arguments_callback returns FALSE. Branch otherwise unchanged v0.20.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: quote-character
options.evidence: src/myloader/myloader_arguments.c arguments_callback: BACKTICK, BT, DOUBLE_QUOTE, DQ compared case-insensitively, the two quote characters exactly (they have no case); anything else logs a critical and reaches common_arguments_callback, which returns FALSE. Unchanged v0.19.1-1..v1.0.8-1 apart from strcasecmp becoming g_ascii_strcasecmp.

options.name: checksum
options.evidence: src/myloader/myloader_arguments.c arguments_callback: FAIL, WARN and SKIP compared case-insensitively (no value means FAIL); anything else logs a critical and reaches common_arguments_callback, which returns FALSE. Unchanged v0.19.1-1..v1.0.8-1.

options.name: purge-mode
options.evidence: src/myloader/myloader_arguments.c arguments_callback: strcmp (case-sensitive) against five modes, else m_error and FALSE. v0.19.1-1..v0.19.3-3.

options.name: purge-mode
options.evidence: src/myloader/myloader_arguments.c arguments_callback: the option only reports its deprecation (m_error) and returns FALSE, so every value is rejected; nothing to record. Removed in v1.0.0-1.
